Descriptor Format of Catalog Entities

Backstage

  • About: The format of every entity in Backstage's software catalog: Component, API, Resource, System and their fields.
  • For this talk: spec.lifecycle already has three well-known values, experimental, production and deprecated: sharing an internal product is moving it to production.

Descriptor Format of Catalog Entities

Backstage

  • Sobre: O formato de toda entidade do catálogo de software do Backstage: Component, API, Resource, System e os seus campos.

Platform tooling

platformengineering.org

  • About: A landscape of platform tools in five planes: Developer Control, Integration & Delivery, Resource, Observability and Security.
